project.title: Multi-VPC AWS Network and Containerized SAR Platform Architecture

parentsummary.deliverables: Architected a five-VPC hub-and-spoke AWS network with site-to-site VPN design for 10 remote sites and a Multi-AZ containerized ECS, PostgreSQL, Kafka/MSK, GIS, and SFTP SAR platform with a zero-downtime migration strategy.
parentsummary.outcomes: Modernized the SAR replacement architecture from legacy SARMASTER hardware to a Multi-AZ containerized AWS design across two Availability Zones supporting backup-site capability and a zero-downtime migration strategy.

challenge.summary: DND's national Search and Rescue (SAR) operations relied on the legacy SARMASTER software and hardware platform, which lacked cloud resilience, Geographic Information System (GIS) integration, live-data ingestion interfaces, and reliable backup-site capability. Replacing a life-safety operational platform demanded 24/7 high availability across Availability Zones, network segmentation across shared and workload tiers, remote-site connectivity, and long-term operational supportability within a 22-month Agile engagement. Without a resilient multi-tier cloud architecture and zero-downtime cut-over plan, national SAR readiness faced prolonged outage risk and ongoing hardware obsolescence.

deliverables: Designed a segmented five-VPC hub-and-spoke AWS network architecture in Canada Central (ca-central-1) interconnected via AWS Transit Gateway across two Availability Zones covering perimeter/identity, common services, site transit, supporting applications, and core SMMS tiers

Architected site-to-site VPN connectivity through a dedicated Site Transit VPC to link 10 remote operational sites, paired with Auto Scaling web proxy, web filtering, and centralized desktop management (ManageEngine Desktop Central)

Designed a three-tier Multi-AZ workload VPC overlay integrating with DND's shared network and perimeter AWS accounts for SSL/TLS ingress, Amazon CloudFront static content delivery, and AWS Transfer for SFTP live-data ingestion

Engineered containerized Amazon ECS (Docker) clusters with EC2 and container Auto Scaling and Dual-AZ Amazon EFS storage to host the core SAR workload alongside nine supporting GIS (GeoServer with S3 spatial data), messaging, and collaboration applications

Architected resilient data and event-streaming tiers using Multi-AZ PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS with synchronous replication, standby failover, read replicas, and RDS snapshot backups alongside Dual-AZ high-availability Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK

Executed staged service testing, failure and high-availability testing, and defined a zero-downtime migration and cut-over strategy to replace legacy SARMASTER infrastructure with backup-site capability
Delivered final architecture documentation, knowledge transfer, and cross-training for Operations, Development, and Management staff

outcomes: Modernized the SAR replacement architecture from legacy SARMASTER hardware to a Multi-AZ containerized AWS design across two Availability Zones, adding backup-site capability, GIS integration, and live-data interfaces for 24/7 Search and Rescue operations

Architected a segmented five-VPC hub-and-spoke network topology with site-to-site VPN design for 10 remote operational sites and nine isolated supporting applications, establishing clear network boundaries across shared and workload tiers
Completed failure and high-availability testing, documented a zero-downtime migration and cut-over strategy, and delivered operations, development, and management cross-training
